question: Does an industry ranked high by a pre-existing industry signal at the signal date earn a positive 6-12 month total return relative to the regional ETF, net of the cost of holding it through its constituents?

KR.universe: PIT KRX Top120 at the signal date (ledger/universe/kr), common shares; preferred shares follow the v4 PREFERRED_SHARE_OF_ANCHORED_COMMON rule

classification.source: KRX/KIND industry label observed AT the signal date, mapped by the frozen v4 14-group crosswalk (research_specs/kr-industry-membership-foundation-v4/crosswalk.json)
classification.version: KR_INDUSTRY_MEMBERSHIP_FOUNDATION_V4 crosswalk; KRICS (announced 2026-09-22) only via a new version
classification.historicalStatus: DATA_FOUNDATION_INSUFFICIENT_V4 (see kr-industry-foundation-status-v1.json); prospective labels are PIT by construction
classification.smallGroups: an industry with < 5 eligible names at the signal date is RECORDED but UNRANKED

KR.megaCap: top-2 signal-date caps of the universe (mechanical, not named) and each basket's top1/top2 cap share

US.universe: S&P 500 members visible at the signal date (us_sector_membership.members_on)

classification.source: datasets/s-and-p-500-companies sector column at the latest commit published before the signal date; the recorder pins that commit and its raw-CSV SHA-256
classification.version: GICS sector level (11 sectors as published); sub-industry not used
classification.staleness: the snapshot age in days is recorded; a snapshot older than 35 days makes the receipt STALE_CLASSIFICATION (recorded, excluded from claims)
classification.rights: dataset label, not an index-provider file; license not verified beyond internal research

US.megaCap: top-2 signal-date caps of the universe and each basket's top1/top2 cap share

signals.rule: limited to pre-existing candidates with existing descriptive readings; definitions as in the sealed KR industry anatomy (research_specs/kr-industry-opportunity-anatomy-v1.json@37f8cbf6); no new feature, no re-measurement here

REL_MOM_126.existingReading: docs/results/kr-industry-opportunity-anatomy-v1-report.md@37f8cbf6 (KR CAP H126 IC and tercile spread, descriptive)

MEDIAN_ocfYieldProxy.existingReading: docs/results/kr-industry-opportunity-anatomy-v1-report.md@37f8cbf6 and docs/research-program/07-market-industry-stock-portfolio-hierarchy-ko.md@37f8cbf6 sec 2.2 (sign not stable across periods)

signals.usNote: US has no historical reading of any of the three; the US leg is an independent prospective sample

construction.cohort: membership and caps fixed at the signal date; returns from the next session close for H126 / H252 sessions
construction.baskets: equal-weight AND cap-weight industry total return, each minus the ETF total return on identical dates
construction.missingConstituent: basket = None and counted (no renormalisation); a refused basket is excluded from BOTH sides of a comparison on that date; > 10% refused baskets on a date makes the date unreadable
construction.terminations: a constituent without terminal consideration makes its basket None (prospective_receipt_core terminal rule)
construction.ranking: industries ranked within date by each signal; top tercile (ties by industry name) vs ETF; top-minus-bottom tercile reported

horizons.cadence: weekly signal dates; one cohort per week

inference.method: Newey-West HAC on the weekly cohort series
inference.multiplicity: Holm one-sided alpha 0.05 over the six H252 claims (top-tercile EW basket - ETF, net 1x cost)
inference.calibrationPrerequisite: a calibration cell for this statistic at the realised depth before any confirmatory read

diagnostics: reading without the universe's top-2 caps (mechanical)
names REPLACED vs weights RETARGETED turnover
share of the signal explained by the market state (TIMING contract states recorded on the same dates)

minimumAccrual.H252: 6 non-overlapping matured H252 windows per region
minimumAccrual.minIndustriesRanked: at least 6 ranked industries per date (KR historical minimum observed 6 sufficient groups)

decision.SUPPORTED: Holm lower bound > 0 at 1x cost AND positive at 2x AND same sign for EW and CAP baskets
decision.CONCENTRATION_DEPENDENT: supported on CAP but not on EW, or vanishes without the top-2 caps
decision.SOURCE_BLOCKED: classification or price source unavailable for > 10% of dates

failureRules: no signal, window, tercile cut, group map or cost is changed after the first counted receipt
KR historical industry results (anatomy, Phase C, integrated v1) are never pooled with receipts
a negative or null read closes this version; KRICS or a new taxonomy is a new contract id
independenceFromStockTrack: reads no stock-track score, rank or selection
stock-within-industry is out of scope; a hierarchy comparison needs its own registration
prerequisites: a KR industry receipt writer (none exists)
a US sector receipt writer that pins the dataset commit (none exists)
owner decision on small-group handling for KR
owner registration before the first counted receipt
